bullets: Built a REST backend in FastAPI over MongoDB serving a React single-page app, with role-based access control for user and admin roles.
Shipped category-wise tracking, budgets with overspending indicators, analytics dashboards, PDF export and an admin panel.

thesis.title: Atrial Fibrillation Detection from PPG Signals in Wearable Devices
thesis.meta: M.Tech thesis, IIT Delhi · Supervisor: Prof. Rahul Garg

teaching.org: Department of Computer Science & Engineering, IIT Delhi
bullets: Data Structures & Algorithms (lab sessions), Analysis & Design of Algorithms (doubt sessions), Theory of Computation (tutorials).

ecg.title: ECG Rhythm Classifier (PhysioNet/CinC 2017 task)
bullets: Built a 3-class (normal / AF / other) softmax logistic regression classifier from scratch over hand-designed features extracted from raw single-lead ECG.
Compared four gradient-descent variants and static class-weighting against focal loss for class imbalance, with metrics that expose minority-class performance.

nn.title: Neural Networks for Indic Language Identification from Audio
bullets: Implemented fully connected networks with backpropagation in NumPy only for Hindi-vs-Bengali and 10-language classification from audio features.
Controlled study of activation (sigmoid / tanh / ReLU), loss (cross-entropy vs MSE), learning-rate schedules and optimisers (SGD, RMSprop, Adam).

nb.title: Prompt-Safety Text Classifier
bullets: Bernoulli and multinomial Naive Bayes over 927,760 prompts; stopword-threshold and n-gram-selection sweeps improved validation accuracy beyond the required margin.

speech.title: Real-Time Offline Hindi-to-Gujarati Speech Translation
bullets: Fully offline speech-to-speech pipeline: Vosk ASR, AI4Bharat translation and Meta MMS-TTS synthesis in a multi-threaded architecture.
About 800 ms end-to-end on CPU and 450 ms on GPU for medium-length sentences; about 97% translation accuracy on the tested set.

game.title: Adversarial Game Agent — Stones and Rivers
bullets: Two-player strategy-game agent using minimax search with board-evaluation heuristics capturing positional and tactical features; learned heuristic weights guide the tree search.

flood.title: Flood Relief Supply Planner
bullets: Modelled relief delivery as constrained optimisation; a local-search solver schedules multi-trip helicopter routes that maximise supply delivered within time and weight bounds.

tpch.title: Memory-Bounded TPC-H Query Engine
bullets: Query execution engine running multi-gigabyte TPC-H workloads under a strict 64 MB memory budget: Volcano-model iterator pipeline, external merge sort and an LRU buffer pool.
Cost-based join selection with a memory-aware fallback to disk-based joins.

runtime.title: Custom Language Runtime — Shell, Compiler, VM, Debugger, GC
bullets: Mini-shell with pipelines, background processes and job control; ptrace-based debugger with software breakpoints and register inspection.
Flex/Bison compiler emitting bytecode for a stack-based virtual machine with its own assembler and a mark-and-sweep garbage collector; all five components integrated behind one shell.

gemm.title: GEMM and Smith–Waterman Acceleration
bullets: Dense matrix multiplication with AVX-512 vectorisation, three-level cache blocking, loop unrolling and 64-byte alignment: 44.31 GFLOP/s, 2.18x over the NumPy baseline up to 12K x 12K.
Smith–Waterman alignment parallelised by anti-diagonal wavefront with AVX-512 and OpenMP: 23x over the sequential C baseline on a 4-core CPU.

cuda.title: GPU-Accelerated Local Histogram Equalisation
bullets: CUDA kernels with KNN and K-Means neighbourhood search; 16.87x (K-Means) and 11.44x (KNN) over a sequential baseline on an NVIDIA Kepler GPU.

mpi.title: Distributed Budgeted Maximum-Weight Clique Solver
bullets: Branch-and-bound across MPI ranks with non-blocking bound sharing, graph-colouring upper bounds and knapsack-relaxation pruning: 6.87x speedup at 12 processes.

Implements models from first principles in NumPy, engineers features from raw signals and evaluates honestly. Seeking ML and data science roles.
skills: NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, Plotly; regression, neural networks, Naive Bayes and SVMs implemented from scratch
ECG/PPG preprocessing, feature engineering, class-imbalance handling, cross-validation, ROC/F1 analysis
Git, Linux, Docker, FastAPI, MongoDB; CUDA and OpenMP for acceleration
thesis: Developing ML models that detect atrial fibrillation from PPG alone, so wearables can screen continuously without ECG, targeting a low false-alarm rate under real-world motion and contact noise.

Built the ECG–PPG synchronisation stage behind beat-level label transfer: sync-point clock correction for device offset and drift, plus an offset scan with beat-by-beat pulse pairing. Verified on the AIIMS and VitalDB cohorts.

Linux, multithreading, ptrace, GDB, Flex/Bison, Git, Docker
OpenMP, MPI, CUDA, AVX-512 SIMD, cache-aware optimisation, profiling against baselines
Data structures & algorithms, operating systems, databases, computer architecture, networks
